sources_considered.why: Primary announcement of increased usage limits associated with additional compute arrangements.
Describes capacity plans and long-term spending commitments, not a measured causal comparison of realized costs and growth.
Reviewed financial and compute-efficiency disclosures. Aggregate results do not isolate the effect of a particular capacity addition from demand, model improvements, and other changes.
